title: Vanilla Magic's Edit
description: The ultimate everyday texture pack designed to enhance both your Survival adventures and intense PvP matches.
body:
# **Key Features:**

![Swords](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6e3421bc5473b3d5678bb9851634972001039bc8.png)

**- Immersive Environment:** Beautiful grass and foliage changes, unique Gold Savannas, and crystal-clear water.

**- Clean Interface:** Sleek Dark UI and Hotbar, complete with custom Hardcore Hearts by default and a steak-themed hunger bar.



**- Built for Combat:** Low-profile PvP elements including short swords, short shields, and short fire for maximum visibility, alongside revamped designs for the bow, flint arrows, and Ender Pearls.

**- Enhanced Details:** 3D models for rails and ladders, plus an updated apple texture.



Vanilla 16x Magic's Edit is the ultimate everyday texture pack designed to enhance both your Survival adventures and intense PvP matches. If you love the classic look of Minecraft but want a cleaner, more refined experience without getting tired of flashy or over-the-top textures, this is the pack for you. It keeps the core essence of the game alive while delivering massive quality-of-life improvements.
